title: plugin-charts / plugin-dashboard 测试套件仍有真实网络逃逸(ECONNREFUSED) — 根因与 #3339 不同,需独立定位
body:
Re-homed from #3339 (comment 5232664054 recorded the same ECONNREFUSED noise class in these two packages) at that card's close — PR #4105 fixed the plugin-detail escape and its dev VERIFIED these two have a **different root cause**: neither package reaches `useRecordEditable` or `DetailView` at all, so the #4105 fix does not cover them and the bisect must start fresh.

## Known facts (inherited from #3339 / PR #4105)

- Noise shape: real `fetch` under happy-dom escaping to `127.0.0.1:3000`, tests green (fail-open), stderr polluted with `connect ECONNREFUSED`.
- The efficient localization method is on record in PR #4105: instrument `fetch`/`XMLHttpRequest`/`EventSource` in the root setup files and attribute every escape to its file + call site — attribution beats file-by-file bisection.
- The fix discipline is also on record: test-side doubles scoped to the escaping files, recording every URL so new escapes fail an assertion; NO global error swallowing; product fallbacks stay untouched; MSW only if the repo ever stands up a real MSW harness (it has none today — declared devDependency, zero imports).
- Acceptance bar: the packages' suites run from repo root with **zero** ECONNREFUSED lines in stderr, no assertion weakened.

## Not yet known

Which test files / call sites in plugin-charts and plugin-dashboard emit the requests, and what endpoint(s) they hit. That is this card's work.

Filed unassigned for the queue; observation provenance stays on #3339's thread.
